purpose: Measure a NEW coordinated18 joint finite-perturbation class; preserve original0/288 single-joint negative. This is CPU causal discovery, not GPU training.
inputs: Same frozen checkpoint/XML/cfg and original ramp, commands, seed 0, DR 0, and starts 0/π as reviewed bank. Copy assets; never regenerate. Same safety and motor and deterministic prefix.

screen.states: Original eight states: wz ±.15 × starts 0/π × original P1=600/P2=638 selected by actual phase
screen.timing: 5 control ticks fixedvector then75 unchanged policy ticks;80 tick scoring,100 Hz

mapping.command_domain: vx=.08, wz=+.15 or-.15 only; exact wz=0 gives all-zero vector
mapping.phase_rule: wrap actual observed env._phase into[0,2pi); among the two centers for sign(wz), select minimum circular distance; if distances differ by<=1e-12rad, choose lower phase_index
mapping.pulse_rule: Choose template once at burst start and hold that vector for exactly5 control ticks; then75 unchanged policy ticks. Do not reselect inside a burst.
mapping.out_of_domain: No assertion or deployment outside tested commands; no start-label/tick-index lookup in vector selection.

screen.pulse_layer: After SB3 predict clipping: add vector, clip all coordinates to action-space bounds, then normal environment safety/servo/physics. Record actual per-coordinate dose and all clip hits.
screen.exactness: All zero controls must pass full integration/controller prefix and endpoint state and trace parity against continuous baseline BEFORE nonzero branches. Every pulse prefix must match. Fail closed on missing metrics; preserve original last-solve yaw plus trueendpoint diagnostic.

measurements.retention: Each branch: complete 80 ticks; positive baseline body forward; branch body forward>=.9baseline; loaded material contact distance<=1.25baseline; relative roll/pitch maxima<=baseline +3 degrees; no termination; all walking ticks. Report loaded foot-seconds and material slip speed separately.
measurements.linear_prediction: Descriptive heuristic only. Sum of absolute even-axis residues, 6.23–11.66 mrad, is NOT signed even response and neither quantity is superposable.

screen_decision.primary: Same actual positive-vector gain>=.005rad and corrected retention. Opposite vector is a paired causal control, never redefined after results.
screen_decision.direction_support: At every qualifying member, odd>0 must hold; otherwise classify benefit as even/nondirectional facilitation, not support for the gradient-sign direction. Report stronger5 mrad reversal separately: Gplus>=.005 AND Gminus<=-.005. Do not silently substitute that stronger criterion for primary.
screen_decision.repeatability: Preserve prior matched phase rule: at a SINGLE GLOBAL amplitude, for EACH yaw command sign at least one phase-neighborhood template must meetprimary+direction support in BOTH starts. A qualifying template also requires retention on its opposite-vector branches. No one-state bestcase qualifies.
screen_decision.dose_selection: Choose .025 if it qualifies globally, otherwise .05 if it qualifies globally, otherwise STOP this proposal. No per-state or per-joint dose fitting, new amplitudes, new seeds, or retuned templates.
screen_decision.scope: Screen pass licenses only the prespecified heldout diagnostic. No PPO directly from these eight discovery states; no sustained steering or whole-class closure.

conditional_holdouts.freeze: Keep ALL four templates, nearest phase rule/tie handling and chosen global dose unchanged. No refit on heldout results.
conditional_holdouts.quarterphase_states: For each originalcell/start, target phases phase(P1)+pi/2 and phase(P2)+pi/2. Select nearest actual phase among ticks[P+10,P+25] independently of response; use earliest tick on an exact distance tie. Freeze selectedticks from continuous baseline before branches. Baseline length>=755 ticks supports full 80 tick windows. Eight new states;three variants each (zero,+chosen,-chosen)=24 branches.
conditional_holdouts.boundary_warning: Quarter-phase targets lie near boundaries between two centers. The JSON lowest phase index tie rule is fixed. Two closely matched starts may straddle the boundary and selectdifferent templates; this is a genuine test of this piecewise mapping, never grounds for post-hoc reassignment.
conditional_holdouts.gate: Same5 mrad primary, odd direction and corrected retention; require support across BOTHstarts and BOTHyaw command signs by the same prespecified matched phase pairing rule. Report eachquarter neighborhood separately; no swapping state pairs after observing outcomes. A failure means no validated generalization for this frozen mapping.
conditional_holdouts.straight: Exact wz = 0 maps tozero regardless of phase. Check two starts on original 15-second vx=.08,wz=0 protocol versus untouched policy: full state and trace parity and original straight retention bars. Label this a zero-off behavior check, not learned straight walking evidence.
conditional_holdouts.before_any_2M_canary: The discovery and holdout results alone do not define a recurring closed-loop deployment. A fully specified state/phase trigger and burst schedule must be frozen and evaluated on original 15-second both continuous yaw signs and straight panel under unchanged qualification/retention bars. No invented PPO arm or canary is included in this proposal.

norm_accounting.interpretation: Larger total norm and energy and potentially greater realized motion; new perturbation class, not overturning single-dimension result or matched total dose claim.
